title: Glenn Vanderburg of LivingSocial on why software development is an engineering discipline
summary: Glenn Vanderburg argues at the O'Reilly Software Architecture Conference that software development is an engineering discipline, even if immature. He contends the discredited body of knowledge called software engineering has led people to wrongly reject the label.
why: Recommended in debates over whether software is real engineering, as a well-argued case that building is cheap relative to simulating.
